message:
Last winter, we braced ourselves for a big snowstorm. As the flurries started, our family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree. My daughter was busy sending updates on how the roads looked, while my son was sharing a picture of his makeshift snow fort. 

I just sat back, sipped my tea, and chuckled at their banter. It reminded me that while it’s good to have supplies on hand, a little humor and connection can be just as important. 

So, I sent a message saying I was fully stocked on hot cocoa and ready for a game night, if anyone could make it through the snow. How do you keep spirits up during a storm? ☕
